Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring fair payment for chiropractic services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fair payment for chiropractic services; andadding a new section to chapter 48.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A health carrier may not develop and use provider and benefitpayment methodologies that pay for chiropractic services in a lesseramount than the carrier pays for substantially similar health careservices provided by a different profession. The carrier may not usea payment methodology that would pay chiropractors less than any othertype of provider for the same billing and payment code. (2) This section applies only to payment methodologies developed orused on and after January 1, 2009.
